model_annotation:
The figure consists of two line plots, both illustrating the training rewards over steps for different models. The x-axis represents the steps, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 500, and tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis represents the training rewards, also with a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 for the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 for the bottom plot, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1 and 0.1 respectively.

The top plot compares the training rewards for "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" models on an easy training set. The "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" model is represented by a blue solid line, starting at approximately 0.0 training rewards at 0 steps and increasing to around 0.3 at 500 steps, with a shaded region indicating variability around the mean. The "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" model is represented by a red solid line, also starting at 0.0 training rewards, and rising to about 0.35 at 500 steps, with a similar shaded region.

The bottom plot compares the training rewards for "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" models on a hard training set. The "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" model is again represented by a blue solid line, starting at 0.0 and decreasing to approximately 0.0 at 500 steps. The "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" model is represented by a red solid line, starting at 0.0, increasing to around 0.15 at 500 steps, with a shaded region indicating variability.
